description: Make the bot leave a server. It can only come back through a new invite from someone with Manage Server, and its own role there is deleted. Always previews first and asks for confirmation. The server must be named: this never falls back to the default one. When two of your bots are in the server, bot says which one leaves.

bot.description: Which bot to act as, by name, when more than one is configured. Omit to use the default bot, or with a server, the bot that handles it.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

guild.description: Server name or ID to leave.

name: leave_server
title: Leave server
